title: Spiky Ball
description:
It's a little ExGFX that I had for idea seeing all these ugly stacked Munchers in some Kaizo-styles hacks. You could enjoy this sweet spike ball unless Munchers that cannot be displayed without a soil!

Technical details:
-Uses palette 4-
-To use it in another animated tile frame panel, just copy-paste from the basis ExGFX to your complete ExGFX-

Hope you'll like it!
